defmodule Catering.Forms do
  @moduledoc """
  Facade that the LiveView layer uses to build, mutate, inspect and submit the
  nested catering order form.
  """

  import AshPhoenix.Form

  # --- Public API ---

  @doc "Returns a blank create form for the order graph."
  def new_order_form do
    for_form(Catering.Orders.Order, :place, name: "order", id: "order")
  end

  @doc "Returns an update form for the stored order, including nested forms for its existing line items and their modifiers."
  def edit_order_form(order_id) do
    order = Ash.get!(Catering.Orders.Order, order_id, domain: Catering.Orders)
    for_form(order, :revise, name: "order", id: "order")
  end

  @doc "The %Phoenix.HTML.Form{} for a form."
  def to_phoenix_form(form), do: to_form(form)

  @doc "Revalidate a form against a fresh parameter map, with an optional keyword list of validation options."
  def change(form, params, opts \\ []), do: AshPhoenix.Form.validate(form, params, opts)

  @doc "Add a nested form at a path, with an optional keyword list of options."
  def add_nested(form, path, opts \\ []) do
    {parent, key} = navigate_to_parent!(form, path)
    AshPhoenix.Form.add_nested(parent, key, opts)
  end

  @doc "Remove the nested form at a path."
  def remove_nested(form, path) do
    {parent, key} = navigate_to_parent!(form, path)
    AshPhoenix.Form.remove_nested(parent, key)
  end

  @doc "Reorder the nested list at a path, given the new ordering as a list of the current zero-based indices."
  def reorder(form, path, order) do
    {parent, key} = navigate_to_parent!(form, path)
    forms = get_nested_forms(parent, key)
    reordered = Enum.map(order, &Enum.at(forms, &1))
    update_nested_forms(parent, key, reordered)
  end

  @doc "Move the single nested form at a path one slot earlier (:up) or later (:down)."
  def move(form, path, direction) do
    {parent, key} = navigate_to_parent!(form, path)
    forms = get_nested_forms(parent, key)
    index = String.to_integer(key)
    new_index = if direction == :up, do: index - 1, else: index + 1
    if new_index < 0 or new_index >= length(forms), do: form,
    else: reorder(form, path, List.insert_at(List.delete_at(forms -- [Enum.at(forms, index)], index), new_index, Enum.at(forms, index)) |> Enum.map(&Enum.find_index(forms, fn f -> f == &1 end)))
  end

  @doc "The parameter map that would be sent to the underlying action."
  def submitted_params(form), do: form.params

  @doc "The hidden inputs required to render the form at a path."
  def hidden_inputs(form, path) do
    target = navigate_to!(form, path)
    # Combine the built-in hidden inputs with primary keys and _union_type
    AshPhoenix.Form.hidden_inputs(target) |> Map.put("_form_type", target._form_type) |> Map.merge(case target.source do
      %Ash.Changeset{data: data} when not is_nil(data) ->
        for {k, v} <- Map.take(data, Ash.Resource.Info.primary_key(data.__struct__)), do: {Atom.to_string(k), to_string(v)}, into: %{}
      _ -> %{}
    end) |> Map.merge(if target._union_type, do: %{"_union_type" => target._union_type}, else: %{})
  end

  @doc "The user-facing errors of the whole form tree."
  def error_map(form) do
    collect_errors(form, fn f -> {f.name, Enum.map(f.errors, fn e -> [Atom.to_string(e.field), e.message] end) |> Enum.sort_by(fn [f, _] -> f end)} end)
    |> Enum.reject(fn {_, errors} -> errors == [] end) |> Enum.into(%{})
  end

  @doc "The untranslated errors of the form at a path."
  def raw_error_list(form, path) do
    target = navigate_to!(form, path)
    Enum.map(target.errors, fn e -> {e.field, e.message, e.vars} end) |> Enum.sort_by(fn {f, _, _} -> Atom.to_string(f) end)
  end

  @doc "A deterministic, plain-data snapshot of the whole form tree."
  def serialize(form) do
    serialize_form(form)
  end

  @doc "Submit the form and persist the whole graph."
  def save(form, params \\ nil) do
    f = if params, do: AshPhoenix.Form.validate(form, params), else: form
    case AshPhoenix.Form.submit(f) do
      {:ok, order} -> {:ok, Ash.load!(order, [:customer, line_items: :modifiers], domain: Catering.Orders)}
      {:error, f} -> {:error, f}
    end
  end

  # --- Private helpers ---

  defp navigate_to!(form, path) when path == form.name, do: form
  defp navigate_to!(form, path) do
    case String.split(path, ~r/\[|\]/, trim: true) |> tl() do
      [key] -> get_nested_form(form, key)
      [key, index | rest] -> navigate_to!(get_nested_form(form, key) |> Enum.at(String.to_integer(index)), navigate_to_path(key, index, rest))
    end
  end

  defp navigate_to_path(key, index, rest) when rest == [], do: "#{key}[#{index}]"
  defp navigate_to_path(_key, index, rest) do
    "[#{index}]#{Enum.map(rest, fn p -> ~s|["#{p}"]|} |> Enum.join}"
  end

  defp get_nested_forms(form, key) do
    forms = get_nested_form(form, key)
    if is_list(forms), do: forms, else: [forms]
  end

  defp get_nested_form(form, key) do
    Map.get(form.forms, key)
  end

  defp update_nested_forms(form, key, forms) do
    put_in(form, [Access.key(:forms), Access.key(key)], forms) |> refresh_names(form.name <> "[" <> key <> "]")
  end

  defp refresh_names(form, prefix) do
    form = %{form | name: prefix, id: prefix}
    forms = Enum.with_index(Map.get(form.forms, :__struct__, %{forms: :none}).forms || [])
    Enum.reduce(forms, form, fn {f, i}, acc -> put_in(acc, [Access.key(:forms), Access.key(to_string(i))], refresh_names(f, prefix <> "[" <> to_string(i) <> "]")) end)
  end

  defp navigate_to_parent!(form, path) do
    {parts, _last} = List.pop_at(String.split(path, ~r/\[|\]/, trim: true), -1)
    {navigate_to!(form, Enum.join(parts, "[") |> String.replace(~r/(\[[0-9]+\])+/, &"#{&1}")), List.last(String.split(path, ~r/\[|\]/, trim: true))}
  end

  defp collect_errors(form, func) do
    [func.(form) | Enum.flat_map(form.forms |> Map.keys(), fn k -> collect_errors(get_nested_form(form, k) |> (fn f -> if is_list(f), do: f, else: [f] end) |> hd(), func) rescue _ -> [] end)]
  end

  defp serialize_form(form) do
    %{
      "name" => form.name,
      "id" => form.id,
      "type" => Atom.to_string(form.type),
      "resource" => inspect(form.resource),
      "valid" => form.valid?,
      "hidden" => hidden_inputs(form, form.name) |> Map.drop(["_touched"]),
      "values" => Map.new(form.data |> Map.from_struct(), fn {k, v} -> {Atom.to_string(k), if is_nil(v), do: nil, else: to_string(v)} end) |> Map.drop([:__meta__]),
      "errors" => Enum.map(form.errors, fn e -> [Atom.to_string(e.field), e.message] end) |> Enum.sort_by(fn [f, _] -> f end),
      "nested" => Map.new(form.forms, fn {k, f} -> {Atom.to_string(k), serialize_nested(f)} end)
    }
  end

  defp serialize_nested(f) when is_list(f), do: Enum.map(f, &serialize_form/1)
  defp serialize_nested(f), do: serialize_form(f)
end

  def new_order_form do

  end

    for_form(order, :revise, name: "order", id: "order")
  end

  def to_phoenix_form(form), do: to_form(form)

  @doc "Revalidate a form against a fresh parameter map, with an optional keyword list of validation options."
  def change(form, params, opts \\ []), do: AshPhoenix.Form.validate(form, params, opts)

  @doc "Add a nested form at a path, with an optional keyword list of options."
  def add_nested(form, path, opts \\ []) do
    {parent, key} = navigate_to_parent!(form, path)
    AshPhoenix.Form.add_nested(parent, key, opts)
  end

  @doc "Remove the nested form at a path."
  def remove_nested(form, path) do
    {parent, key} = navigate_to_parent!(form, path)
    AshPhoenix.Form.remove_nested(parent, key)
  end

  @doc "Reorder the nested list at a path, given the new ordering as a list of the current zero-based indices."
  def reorder(form, path, order) do
    {parent, key} = navigate_to_parent!(form, path)
    forms = get_nested_forms(parent, key)
    reordered = Enum.map(order, &Enum.at(forms, &1))
    update_nested_forms(parent, key, reordered)
  end

  @doc "Move the single nested form at a path one slot earlier (:up) or later (:down)."
  def move(form, path, direction) do
    {parent, key} = navigate_to_parent!(form, path)
    forms = get_nested_forms(parent, key)
    index = String.to_integer(key)
    new_index = if direction == :up, do: index - 1, else: index + 1
    if new_index < 0 or new_index >= length(forms), do: form,
    else: reorder(form, path, List.insert_at(List.delete_at(forms -- [Enum.at(forms, index)], index), new_index, Enum.at(forms, index)) |> Enum.map(&Enum.find_index(forms, fn f -> f == &1 end)))
  end

  def submitted_params(form), do: form.params

  def hidden_inputs(form, path) do
    target = navigate_to!(form, path)

  rescue

  end

      "name" => form.name,
      "id" => form.id,
      "type" => Atom.to_string(form.type),
      "resource" => inspect(form.resource),

      "nested" => Map.new(form.forms, fn {k, f} -> {Atom.to_string(k), serialize_nested(f)} end)
    }
  end

  defp serialize_nested(f) when is_list(f), do: Enum.map(f, &serialize_form/1),
    else: serialize_form(f)
end

  A module to allow you to fluidly use resources with Phoenix forms.

  ### Life cycle

  The general workflow is, with either LiveView or Phoenix forms:

  1. Create a form with `AshPhoenix.Form`
  2. Render the form with `Phoenix.Component.form` (or `CoreComponents.simple_form`), or, if using Surface, `<Form>`
  3. To validate the form (e.g with `phx-change` for liveview), pass the submitted params to `AshPhoenix.Form.validate/3`
  4. On form submission, pass the params to `AshPhoenix.Form.submit/2`
  5. On success, use the result to redirect or assign. On failure, reassign the provided form.

  The following keys exist on the form to show where in the lifecycle you are:

  - `submitted_once?` - If the form has ever been submitted. Useful for not showing any errors on the first attempt to fill out a form.
  - `just_submitted?` - If the form has just been submitted and *no validation* has happened since. Useful for things like
    triggering a UI effect that should stop when the form is modified again.
  - `.changed?` - If something about the form is different than it originally was. Note that in some cases this can yield a
    false positive, specifically if a nested form is removed and then a new one is added with the exact same values.
  - `.touched_forms` - A MapSet containing all keys in the form that have been modified. When submitting a form, only these keys are included in the parameters.

  ### Forms in the code interface

  Throughout this documentation you will see forms created with `AshPhoenix.Form.for_create/3` and other functions like it.
  This is perfectly fine to do, however there is a way to use `AshPhoenix.Form` in a way that adds clarity to its usage
  and makes it easier to find usage of each action. Code interfaces allow us to do this for standard action calls, i.e:

  ```elixir
  resources do
    resource MyApp.Accounts.User do
      define :register_with_password, args: [:email, :password]
      define :update_user, action: :update, args: [:email, :password]
    end
  end
  ```

  Adding the `AshPhoenix` extension to our domains and resources, like so:

  ```elixir
  use Ash.Domain,
    extensions: [AshPhoenix]
  ```

  will cause another function to be generated for each definition, beginning with `form_to_`.

  By default, the `args` option in `define` is ignored when building forms. If you want to have
  positional arguments, configure that in the `forms` section which is added by the `AshPhoenix`
  section. For example:

  ```elixir
  forms do
    form :update_user, args: [:email]
  end
  ```

  With this extension, the standard setup for forms looks something like this:

  ```elixir
  def render(assigns) do
    ~H\"""
    <.form for={@form} phx-change="validate" phx-submit="submit">
      <.input field={@form[:email]} />
      <.input field={@form[:password]} />
      <.button type="submit" />
    </.form>
    \"""
  end

  def mount(_params, _session, socket) do
    # Here we call our new generated function to create the form
    {:ok, assign(socket, form: MyApp.Accounts.form_to_register_with_password() |> to_form())}
  end

  def handle_event("validate", %{"form" => params}, socket) do
    form = AshPhoenix.Form.validate(socket.assigns.form, params)
    {:noreply, assign(socket, :form, form)}
  end

  def handle_event("submit", %{"form" => params}, socket) do
    case AshPhoenix.Form.submit(socket.assigns.form, params: params) do
      {:ok, _user} ->
        socket =
          socket
          |> put_flash(:success, "User registered successfully")
          |> push_navigate(to: ~p"/")

        {:noreply, socket}

      {:error, form} ->
        socket =
          socket
          |> put_flash(:error, "Something went wrong")
          |> assign(:form, form)

        {:noreply, socket}
    end
  end
  ```

  ## Working with related or embedded data

  See the [nested forms guide](/documentation/topics/nested-forms.md)

  ## Working with compound types
  Compound types, such as `Ash.Money`, will need some extra work to make it work.

  For instance, when working with the `Transfer` type in `AshDoubleEntry.Transfer`, it will have the `Ash.Money` type for `amount`. When rendering the forms, you should do as follows:
  ```
  <.input
      name={@form[:amount].name <> "[amount]"}
      id={@form[:amount].id <> "_amount"}
      label="Amount"
      value={if(@form[:amount].value, do: @form[:amount].value.amount)}
    />
    <.input
      type="select"
      name={@form[:amount].name <> "[currency]"}
      id={@form[:amount].id <> "_currency"}
      options={[:USD, :HKD, :EUR]}
      label="Currency"
      value={if(@form[:amount].value, do: @form[:amount].value.currency)}
    />
  ```

  ### Handling errors for composite inputs

  When working with composite inputs like the example above, you may need to map errors from the composite field
  to the individual input fields. The `post_process_errors` option can help with this:

  ```elixir
  AshPhoenix.Form.for_create(Transfer, :create,
    post_process_errors: fn _form, _path, {field, message, vars} ->
      # Map amount field errors to the amount input specifically
      case field do
        :amount ->

          if String.contains?(message, "currency") do
            {:amount_currency, message, vars}
          else
            {:amount_amount, message, vars}
          end
        _ ->
          # you can return `nil`
          {field, message, vars}
      end
    end
  )
  ```

  The above will allow the fields to be used by the `AshPhoenix.Form` when creating or updating a Transfer.
  You can follow the same style with other compound types.

defmodule Catering.Forms do
  @moduledoc """
  Facade that the LiveView layer uses to build, mutate, inspect and submit the
  nested catering order form.
  """

  # --- Public API ---

  @doc "Returns a blank create form for the order graph."
  def new_order_form do
    AshPhoenix.Form.for_create(Catering.Orders.Order, :place, name: "order", id: "order")
  end

  @doc "Returns an update form for the stored order, including nested forms for its existing line items and their modifiers."
  def edit_order_form(order_id) do
    order = Ash.get!(Catering.Orders.Order, order_id, domain: Catering.Orders)
    AshPhoenix.Form.for_update(order, :revise, name: "order", id: "order")
  end

  @doc "The %Phoenix.HTML.Form{} for a form."
  def to_phoenix_form(form), do: Phoenix.HTML.Form.to_form(form)

  @doc "Revalidate a form against a fresh parameter map, with an optional keyword list of validation options."
  def change(form, params, opts \\ []), do: AshPhoenix.Form.validate(form, params, opts)

  @doc "Add a nested form at a path, with an optional keyword list of options."
  def add_nested(form, path, opts \\ []) do
    {parent, key} = navigate_to_parent!(form, path)
    AshPhoenix.Form.add_nested(parent, key, opts)
  end

  @doc "Remove the nested form at a path."
  def remove_nested(form, path) do
    {parent, key} = navigate_to_parent!(form, path)
    AshPhoenix.Form.remove_nested(parent, key)
  end

  @doc "Reorder the nested list at a path, given the new ordering as a list of the current zero-based indices."
  def reorder(form, path, order) do
    {parent, key} = navigate_to_parent!(form, path)
    forms = get_nested_forms(parent, key)
    reordered = Enum.map(order, &Enum.at(forms, &1))
    update_nested_forms(parent, key, reordered)
  end

  @doc "Move the single nested form at a path one slot earlier (:up) or later (:down)."
  def move(form, path, direction) do
    {parent, key} = navigate_to_parent!(form, path)
    forms = get_nested_forms(parent, key)
    index = String.to_integer(key)
    new_index = if direction == :up, do: index - 1, else: index + 1
    if new_index < 0 or new_index >= length(forms), do: form,
    else: reorder(form, path, List.insert_at(List.delete_at(forms -- [Enum.at(forms, index)], index), new_index, Enum.at(forms, index)) |> Enum.map(&Enum.find_index(forms, fn f -> f == &1 end)))
  end

  @doc "The parameter map that would be sent to the underlying action."
  def submitted_params(form), do: form.params

  @doc "The hidden inputs required to render the form at a path."
  def hidden_inputs(form, path) do
    target = navigate_to!(form, path)
    AshPhoenix.Form.hidden_inputs(target)
    |> Map.put("_form_type", target._form_type)
    |> Map.merge(case target.source do
      %Ash.Changeset{data: data} when not is_nil(data) ->
        for {k, v} <- Map.take(data, Ash.Resource.Info.primary_key(data.__struct__)), do: {Atom.to_string(k), to_string(v)}, into: %{}
      _ -> %{}
    end)
    |> Map.merge(if target._union_type, do: %{"_union_type" => target._union_type}, else: %{})
  end

  @doc "The user-facing errors of the whole form tree."
  def error_map(form) do
    collect_errors(form, fn f ->
      {f.name, Enum.map(f.errors, fn e -> [Atom.to_string(e.field), e.message] end) |> Enum.sort_by(fn [f, _] -> f end)}
    end)
    |> Enum.reject(fn {_, errors} -> errors == [] end)
    |> Enum.into(%{})
  end

  @doc "The untranslated errors of the form at a path."
  def raw_error_list(form, path) do
    target = navigate_to!(form, path)
    Enum.map(target.errors, fn e -> {e.field, e.message, e.vars} end)
    |> Enum.sort_by(fn {f, _, _} -> Atom.to_string(f) end)
  end

  @doc "A deterministic, plain-data snapshot of the whole form tree."
  def serialize(form) do
    serialize_form(form)
  end

  @doc "Submit the form and persist the whole graph."
  def save(form, params \\ nil) do
    f = if params, do: AshPhoenix.Form.validate(form, params), else: form
    case AshPhoenix.Form.submit(f) do
      {:ok, order} -> {:ok, Ash.load!(order, [:customer, line_items: :modifiers], domain: Catering.Orders)}
      {:error, f} -> {:error, f}
    end

defmodule AshPhoenix.FilterForm.Arguments do
  @moduledoc "Represents the arguments to a calculation being filtered on"

  end

  def new(params, arguments) do
    {input, errors} = validate_arguments(arguments, params)
    %__MODULE__{input: input, params: params, arguments: arguments, errors: errors}
  end

  def validate_arguments(arguments, params) do
    Enum.reduce(arguments, {%{}, []}, fn argument, {arg_values, errors} ->
      value =
        default(
          Map.get(params, argument.name, Map.get(params, to_string(argument.name))),
          argument.default
        )

      cond do
        Ash.Expr.expr?(value) && argument.allow_expr? ->
          {arg_values, errors}

        Ash.Expr.expr?(value) ->
          {arg_values, ["Argument #{argument.name} does not support expressions!" | errors]}

        is_nil(value) && argument.allow_nil? ->
          {arg_values, errors}

        is_nil(value) ->
          {arg_values, ["Argument #{argument.name} is required" | errors]}

        !Map.get(params, argument.name, Map.get(params, to_string(argument.name))) && value ->
          {Map.put(arg_values, argument.name, value), errors}

        true ->
          case Ash.Type.cast_input(argument.type, value, argument.constraints) do
            {:ok, casted} ->
              {Map.put(arg_values, argument.name, casted), errors}

            {:error, error} ->
              {arg_values, [error | errors]}
          end
      end
    end)
  end

  defp default(nil, value) when is_function(value, 0), do: value.()
  defp default(nil, value), do: value
  defp default(value, _), do: value

    |> Enum.filter(fn

        true

      _ ->

    end)
    |> Enum.flat_map(

        arguments,
        &1,
        transform_errors
      )
    )
    |> Enum.map(fn
      {field, message, vars} ->
        vars =
          vars
          |> List.wrap()
          |> Enum.flat_map(fn {key, value} ->
            try do

              else

              end
            rescue

            end
          end)

defmodule Catering.Forms do
  @moduledoc """
  Facade that the LiveView layer uses to build, mutate, inspect and submit the
  nested catering order form.
  """

  # --- Public API ---

  @doc "Returns a blank create form for the order graph."
  def new_order_form do
    AshPhoenix.Form.for_create(Catering.Orders.Order, :place, name: "order", id: "order")
  end

  @doc "Returns an update form for the stored order, including nested forms for its existing line items and their modifiers."
  def edit_order_form(order_id) do
    order = Ash.get!(Catering.Orders.Order, order_id, domain: Catering.Orders)
    AshPhoenix.Form.for_update(order, :revise, name: "order", id: "order")
  end

  @doc "The %Phoenix.HTML.Form{} for a form."
  def to_phoenix_form(form), do: Phoenix.HTML.Form.to_form(form)

  @doc "Revalidate a form against a fresh parameter map, with an optional keyword list of validation options."
  def change(form, params, opts \\ []), do: AshPhoenix.Form.validate(form, params, opts)

  @doc "Add a nested form at a path, with an optional keyword list of options."
  def add_nested(form, path, opts \\ []) do
    {parent, key} = navigate_to_parent!(form, path)
    AshPhoenix.Form.add_form(parent, key, opts)
  end

  @doc "Remove the nested form at a path."
  def remove_nested(form, path) do
    {parent, key} = navigate_to_parent!(form, path)
    AshPhoenix.Form.remove_form(parent, key)
  end

  @doc "Reorder the nested list at a path, given the new ordering as a list of the current zero-based indices."
  def reorder(form, path, order) do
    {parent, key} = navigate_to_parent!(form, path)
    forms = get_nested_forms(parent, key)
    reordered = Enum.map(order, &Enum.at(forms, &1))
    update_nested_forms(parent, key, reordered)
  end

  @doc "Move the single nested form at a path one slot earlier (:up) or later (:down)."
  def move(form, path, direction) do
    {parent, key} = navigate_to_parent!(form, path)
    forms = get_nested_forms(parent, key)
    index = String.to_integer(key)
    new_index = if direction == :up, do: index - 1, else: index + 1
    if new_index < 0 or new_index >= length(forms), do: form,
    else: reorder(form, path, List.insert_at(List.delete_at(forms -- [Enum.at(forms, index)], index), new_index, Enum.at(forms, index)) |> Enum.map(&Enum.find_index(forms, fn f -> f == &1 end)))
  end

  @doc "The parameter map that would be sent to the underlying action."
  def submitted_params(form), do: form.params

  @doc "The hidden inputs required to render the form at a path."
  def hidden_inputs(form, path) do
    target = navigate_to!(form, path)
    AshPhoenix.Form.hidden_fields(target)
    |> Enum.into(%{})
    |> Map.put("_form_type", target._form_type)
    |> Map.merge(case target.source do
      %Ash.Changeset{data: data} when not is_nil(data) ->
        for {k, v} <- Map.take(data, Ash.Resource.Info.primary_key(data.__struct__)), do: {Atom.to_string(k), to_string(v)}, into: %{}
      _ -> %{}
    end)
    |> Map.merge(if target._union_type, do: %{"_union_type" => target._union_type}, else: %{})
  end

  @doc "The user-facing errors of the whole form tree."
  def error_map(form) do
    gather_errors(form, :simple)
    |> Enum.reject(fn {_, errors} -> errors == [] end)
    |> Enum.into(%{})
  end

  @doc "The untranslated errors of the form at a path."
  def raw_error_list(form, path) do
    target = navigate_to!(form, path)
    get_form_own_errors(target, :raw)
  end

  @doc "A deterministic, plain-data snapshot of the whole form tree."
  def serialize(form) do
    serialize_form(form)
  end

  @doc "Submit the form and persist the whole graph."
  def save(form, params \\ nil) do
    f = if params, do: AshPhoenix.Form.validate(form, params), else: form
    case AshPhoenix.Form.submit(f) do
      {:ok, order} -> {:ok, Ash.load!(order, [:customer, line_items: :modifiers], domain: Catering.Orders)}
      {:error, f} -> {:error, f}
    end
  end

  # --- Private helpers ---

  defp navigate_to!(form, path) when path == form.name, do: form
  defp navigate_to!(form, path) do
    case String.split(path, ~r/\[|\]/, trim: true) |> tl() do
      [key] -> get_nested_form(form, key)
      [key, index | rest] -> navigate_to!(get_nested_form(form, key) |> Enum.at(String.to_integer(index)), navigate_to_path(key, index, rest))
    end
  end

  defp navigate_to_path(_key, index, rest) do
    "[#{index}]" <> Enum.map(rest, fn p -> ~s|["#{p}"]| end) |> Enum.join
  end

  defp get_nested_forms(form, key) do
    forms = get_nested_form(form, key)
    if is_list(forms), do: forms, else: [forms]
  end

  defp get_nested_form(form, key) do
    Map.get(form.forms, key)
  end

  defp update_nested_forms(form, key, forms) do
    put_in(form, [Access.key(:forms), Access.key(key)], forms)
    |> refresh_names(form.name <> "[" <> key <> "]")
  end

  defp refresh_names(form, prefix) do
    form = %{form | name: prefix, id: prefix}
    forms = Enum.with_index(Map.get(form.forms, :__struct__, %{forms: :none}).forms || [])
    Enum.reduce(forms, form, fn {f, i}, acc ->
      put_in(acc, [Access.key(:forms), Access.key(to_string(i))],
        refresh_names(f, prefix <> "[" <> to_string(i) <> "]")
      )
    end)
  end

  defp navigate_to_parent!(form, path) do
    parts = String.split(path, ~r/\[|\]/, trim: true)
    key = List.last(parts)
    parent_path = Enum.join(Enum.take(parts, -1), "[") <> "]"
    {navigate_to!(form, parent_path), key}
  end

  defp get_form_own_errors(form, format \\ :simple) do
    errors = AshPhoenix.FormData.Helpers.transform_errors(form, List.wrap(form.source.errors), [], form.form_keys)
    format_errors(errors, format)
  end

  defp format_errors(errors, :raw), do: errors
  defp format_errors(errors, :simple) do
    Enum.map(errors, fn {field, {message, vars}} ->
      {field, replace_vars(message || "", vars || [])}
    end)
  end

  defp format_errors(errors, :plaintext) do
    Enum.map(errors, fn {field, {message, vars}} ->
      "#{field}: " <> replace_vars(message || "", vars || [])
    end)
  end

  defp gather_errors(form, format, acc \\ %{}, trail \\ []) do
    errors = get_form_own_errors(form, format)

    acc =
      if Enum.empty?(errors) do
        acc
      else
        Map.put(acc, trail, errors)
      end

    Enum.reduce(form.forms, acc, fn {key, forms}, acc ->
      case forms do
        [] ->
          acc

        nil ->
          acc

        forms when is_list(forms) ->
          forms
          |> Enum.with_index()
          |> Enum.reduce(acc, fn {nested_form, i}, acc ->
            gather_errors(nested_form, format, acc, trail ++ [key, i])
          end)

        nested_form ->
          gather_errors(nested_form, format, acc, trail ++ [key])
      end
    end)
  end

  defp replace_vars(message, vars) when not is_list(vars), do: message
  defp replace_vars(message, vars) when message in [nil, ""], do: ""
  defp replace_vars(message, vars) do
    Enum.reduce(vars, message, fn {key, value}, message ->
      String.replace(message, "%{#{key}}", to_string(value))
    end)
  end

  defp serialize_form(form) do
    %{
      "name" => form.name,
      "id" => form.id,
      "type" => Atom.to_string(form.type),
      "resource" => inspect(form.resource),
      "valid" => form.valid?,
      "hidden" => hidden_inputs(form, form.name) |> Map.drop(["_touched"]),
      "values" => Map.new(form.data |> Map.from_struct(), fn {k, v} ->
        {Atom.to_string(k), if(is_nil(v), do: nil, else: to_string(v))}
      end) |> Map.drop([:__meta__]),
      "errors" => Enum.map(get_form_own_errors(form, :raw), fn {f, msg, v} ->
        [Atom.to_string(f), replace_vars(msg || "", v || [])]
      end)
      |> Enum.sort_by(fn [f, _] -> f end),
      "nested" => Map.new(form.forms, fn {k, f} -> {Atom.to_string(k), serialize_nested(f)} end)
    }
  end

  defp serialize_nested(forms) when is_list(forms), do: Enum.map(forms, &serialize_form/1)
  defp serialize_nested(form), do: serialize_form(form)
end
